steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: State: give a brief factual answer without explanation.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Describe: give a detailed account of what something is or how it works.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Explain: give reasons or causes - say how AND why.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Compare: identify similarities AND differences between two or more items.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: What is the difference between describe and explain? | Q: How should you structure an answer to an evaluate question? | Q: What does a compare answer require that a describe answer does not?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: Describe tells what happens (the process or features); explain tells why it happens (the reasons or mechanisms). | Identify strengths and weaknesses of each option, then make a clear, justified judgement about which is better and why. | A compare answer must identify BOTH similarities AND differences. A describe answer only states features without linking them.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Underline the command word before answering - it tells you exactly what structure is needed. Explain = how + why; Describe = what only; Evaluate = strengths + weaknesses + judgement. Compare requires structured comparative sentences (X is... whereas Y is...). Justify answers must start with a clear choice, then support it with specific reasons. For calculate questions, always write the formula, substitute values, show working and state units.
